description: Land Acquisition - Correction Notice, Ex. Gaz. No. 1422/12 dated 06.12.2005, Ayagama D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains a correction notice regarding the date and time for a land acquisition proceeding, with specific reference numbers related to land ministry and acquisition processes. The content focuses solely on land-related administrative procedures without any government personnel changes, structural modifications, or other non-land matters.
